notes: Egypt lineup from mi.com/eg (every phone on the Egyptian Xiaomi site in this family: the phone list at mi.com/eg/product-list/phone/ plus the newer models linked from mi.com/eg). Colours, Arabic colour names and memory configurations from each model's mi.com/eg specs page; the Egyptian page lists colours and configurations independently, so every listed colour is offered in every listed configuration. English specifications from the same model's mi.com/global specs page (colour swatches are the same files on both, which maps each Arabic colour name to its English name exactly); anything those pages do not state is left empty. Swatch colours are the average of Xiaomi's own colour-swatch images. Product images: Xiaomi publishes clean per-colour images only for some models (official colour-section composites on i02.appmifile.com, served as PNG by Xiaomi's own CDN); the other models only have lifestyle or dark marketing banners, so they are imported as hidden drafts with the image pending instead of using a non-official or unsuitable image. POCO C75 is the only POCO phone on mi.com/eg. The other POCO phones (C, M, X and F series) are listed only on mi.com/global, not on the Egyptian site, so they are not imported.
